title: THE PEDDLER
why: His order of 2026-10-12, make them all look better. The Peddler was a pillager in an amber coat with the rig stripes across it, behind a table with three coloured squares on it. Now he is a travelling trader: a tall pack frame on his back with a bedroll on top and a pot, a coil of rope and a bottle hanging off it, a long leather duster and a wide brimmed hat that nobody else wears, so you know him from across the map. His table has a cloth over it and his stock sits on it as a roll, a box and a can. The lantern and its warm pool stay, the glow now painted once and reused, which is cheaper every frame. His clothes are his own and are never sold.
now: The Peddler is a travelling trader now: a pack frame hung with goods, a duster, a wide hat and a dressed stall.
